description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

An Overview

We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build the intelligence that makes NodeZero's external attack capabilities go beyond deterministic attacks and locate advanced breach vectors.

You'll use AI agent frameworks and reasoning systems that transform fragmented external data into actionable intelligence. That means connecting assets, identities, exposed credentials, infrastructure, and code repositories into a coherent understanding of an organization's external attack surface. You'll develop systems that reason over incomplete information, investigate hypotheses, determine what matters, and intelligently leverage existing offensive capabilities and go beyond them.

The hard part isn't collecting more data or automating another attack technique. It's building AI that can reason through the ambiguity of real-world environments. An exposed credential might connect to an overlooked application, a Git repository might reveal an unexpected trust relationship, and an apparently unrelated domain might provide the missing context for an attack path. Traditional automation struggles with the complexity, uncertainty, and long tail of these relationships. You'll combine agentic architectures, retrieval, graph-based reasoning, and deterministic tools to build systems that can navigate these problems at scale.

Success here isn’t judged by how plausible an answer reads. It’s judged by outcomes: did the agent surface an asset, credential, or attack path our deterministic tools missed, and did it validate it? You’ll build the evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, and production infrastructure that make these systems increasingly capable and reliable. And because they operate in real customer environments, you'll ensure their reasoning and actions remain safe, explainable, and strictly within authorized boundaries.

The goal is to make NodeZero's existing offensive capabilities smarter: turning massive amounts of external intelligence into focused investigation, effective decisions, and validated security outcomes. This is a hands-on Senior-level AI engineering role where you'll own the architecture and production delivery of AI systems for External Attack, partnering closely with attack engineers who build the underlying offensive capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build production-grade agentic AI systems that reason over external attack surface data, investigate hypotheses, plan multi-step workflows, and intelligently orchestrate existing reconnaissance and offensive security tools.

  • Architect the reasoning and orchestration layer for autonomous investigation, including LLM tool use, planning, context engineering, retrieval, memory, state management, and recovery from failed or inconclusive actions.

  • Develop intelligent approaches to information extraction, entity resolution, relationship discovery, and evidence correlation across heterogeneous sources, including DNS, infrastructure metadata, web content, code repositories, exposed credentials, cloud resources, and identity systems.

  • Build AI-driven reasoning over complex relationships between assets, organizations, identities, credentials, and infrastructure. Apply graph-based reasoning, knowledge retrieval, and structured representations to help agents identify meaningful connections and prioritize investigation.

  • Design and own evaluation systems for complex agentic workflows. Develop offline benchmarks, representative test environments, regression suites, and production feedback loops that measure reasoning quality, attribution accuracy, tool-selection effectiveness, hallucinations, reliability, and validated outcomes.

  • Evaluate and integrate frontier and open-weight models, experiment with prompting and context strategies, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, and model adaptation techniques, and select approaches based on measurable improvements in capability, latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Design safeguards for autonomous AI workflows, including scope-aware decision-making, constrained tool permissions, validation of model outputs, auditability, and guardrails.

  • Partner with attack engineers and security researchers to understand external attack workflows, define how AI should interact with established offensive capabilities, and translate domain expertise into agent behaviors, tools, evaluation criteria, and actionable feedback.

  • Own AI capabilities end to end, from early experimentation and architectural design through production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement. Establish engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and help shape the long-term AI technical strategy for External Attack.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong experience building, evaluating, deploying, and maintaining production AI or machine learning systems, with demonstrated technical ownership of complex AI applications beyond prototypes and proofs of concept.

  • Hands-on expertise developing agentic AI applications using large language models, including tool calling, planning, orchestration, retrieval, context management, and multi-step execution in real-world environments.

  • Strong understanding of modern machine learning and LLM architectures, including transformers, embeddings, inference, and the practical tradeoffs between foundation models, specialized ML approaches, and deterministic software.

  • Experience designing rigorous evaluation methodologies for AI systems, particularly open-ended reasoning tasks, agentic workflows, and applications where performance must be measured through observable outcomes rather than simple benchmark scores.

  • Experience building systems that reason over complex, structured and unstructured data, including information extraction, semantic retrieval, entity resolution, knowledge representation, or graph-based analysis.

  • Expert-level Python skills and strong software engineering fundamentals, with a track record of delivering reliable, maintainable production services, APIs, and distributed systems.

  • Experience building and operating AI infrastructure in cloud environments, preferably AWS, with practical knowledge of inference services, data pipelines, observability, scalability, latency optimization, and cost management.

  • Understanding of AI system reliability and safety, including handling untrusted inputs, constraining tool execution, validating model-generated decisions, and diagnosing agent failure modes.

  • Ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies and complex problem domains, rapidly develop technical expertise, and drive ambiguous 0→1 initiatives from concept to production.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to clearly explain complex AI concepts, architectural decisions, experimental findings, and technical tradeoffs to engineers and cross-functional partners.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus 7+ years of professional software or ML engineering experience with substantial hands-on production AI experience.

You do not need to be a penetration tester, exploit developer, or offensive security researcher. We're looking for someone with deep AI engineering expertise who is genuinely interested in learning how attackers discover infrastructure, connect identities, and turn isolated exposures into meaningful attack paths. You'll work alongside engineers who specialize in offensive techniques; your expertise is in building the intelligent systems that make those capabilities more effective.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building sophisticated autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, or AI-driven developer, research, or operational workflows that require planning, tool orchestration, and reliable long-horizon execution.

  • Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks and tooling, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vector databases, model-serving infrastructure, or equivalent custom-built systems.

  • Experience with model post-training or adaptation techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, distillation, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, or training specialized models for domain-specific tasks.

  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, graph databases such as Neo4j, graph-based retrieval, entity resolution, causal reasoning, or search and planning over large state spaces.

  • Experience building AI systems that process large volumes of noisy, incomplete, or adversarial real-world data and make decisions under uncertainty.

  • Experience with offensive security, attack surface management, threat intelligence, external reconnaissance, identity security, or automated penetration testing, particularly in environments involving complex asset and identity relationships.

  • Familiarity with external intelligence sources such as DNS, certificate transparency, internet-wide scanning data, exposed code repositories, cloud asset metadata, and credential exposure datasets.

  • Experience with adversarial robustness, prompt injection defense, model security, or the safe orchestration of tools operating in sensitive or customer-controlled environments.

  • Experience integrating AI capabilities into high-scale, multi-tenant SaaS products, including production inference optimization, continuous evaluation, and operating AI services under real-world reliability and cost constraints.

Travel Required

This job may require up to 10% of travel to be successful.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $263,165 - $309,570 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
